location: The Barrens, at the southern tip
entrance: In the brambles at the southern tip of The Barrens, at /way 42.3 89.9. Turn west just before the Great Lift to Thousand Needles.

1701.objective: Gather the materials Furen Longbeard asks for, among them the Vial of Phlogiston from Roogug, and bring them to him in Stormwind.
1701.note: A Warrior quest at the end of a chain that starts with Yorus Barleybrew.

1142.objective: Find Treshala's Pendant and bring it to Treshala Fallowbrook in Darnassus.
1142.note: The body of Heralath Fallowbrook lies in a tent before the last boss. The pendant drops from the quilboar inside.

1101.objective: Bring Razorflank's Medallion, a drop from Charlga Razorflank, to Falfindel Waywarder in Thalanaar.
1101.note: It follows Lonebrow's Journal, which lies on the body of a dwarf at the foot of the Great Lift.

1838.objective: Bring Thun'grim Firegaze 15 Smoky Iron Ingots, 10 Powdered Azurite, 10 Iron Bars and a Vial of Phlogiston.
1838.note: A Warrior quest. The vial drops from Roogug.

1109.objective: Bring a pile of Kraul Guano to Master Apothecary Faranell.
1109.note: It drops from the Kraul Bats in the bat cave and leads to Hearts of Zeal in Scarlet Monastery.

1102.objective: Bring Razorflank's Heart, a drop from Charlga Razorflank, to Auld Stonespire in Thunder Bluff.

1221.objective: Summon a Snufflenose Gopher from the Crate with Holes, make it dig with the Command Stick, and bring 6 Blueleaf Tubers, the stick and the crate back to Mebok Mizzyrix.
1221.note: Take the crate, the stick and the manual from next to Mebok in Ratchet before you go in.

1144.objective: Escort Willix the Importer out of the dungeon.
1144.note: He is held in a tent before the last boss, and the escort ends at the entrance.
